title: GPT Astra is INSANE! Here’s What You Need to Know.. | OpenAI Update #chatgpt #claude #ainews
description:
GPT Astra is INSANE. 

OpenAI just dropped GPT-6 Astra — the new ChatGPT flagship OpenAI is calling its most intelligent and aligned AI model yet, built to actually use a computer like you do. 

Instead of only chatting, GPT-6 Astra can browse the web, code, run software, build 3D scenes, handle spreadsheets, and complete multi-step work across apps with state-of-the-art computer use, software engineering, science, and professional workflows, scoring 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3 and rolling out soon to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and the OpenAI API. 

If you’re searching “OpenAI GPT-6 Astra,” “new ChatGPT model,” or “AI that uses your computer,” this is the update: anything you can do on a computer, Astra can do for you — fast.
